verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter publishes one provider-side timing commitment: it opens the case file within 24–48 hours of a signed agreement. It also lists an article on what NIW premium processing speeds up, which points to government-timeline guidance, but no actual USCIS processing times are quoted. missing for 10: a stated attorney preparation/drafting time to I-140 filing, published USCIS/government processing time estimates (standard vs. premium), an end-to-end timeline, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on

citations.quote: We open your case file within 24 to 48 hours of receiving your signed agreement.
